title: How to stop screwing yourself over | Mel Robbins | TEDxSF
summary: Mel Robbins gives a TEDxSF talk on why people sabotage themselves and how to push past hesitation. It is the source of her 'count backward from five' technique.
why: HN mostly cites it in discussions of procrastination and the 5-second rule, not as a strong recommendation.

quote.text: TL;DR: when tempted by procrastination count backward from 5
